name: Highperch
summary: Highperch is an elevated plateau in western Thousand Needles, towering high above the canyon floor. It is renowned as a primary nesting ground for wild wyverns and wind riders. The roost is home to fierce prides defending their young among the windswept crags.

sections.title: Aerie of the Wyverns
sections.body: Rising sharply out of the canyon floor, Highperch is a rugged sanctuary for Kalimdor's native wyverns. The plateau provides natural defense against predators and an unobstructed launch point for their hunting flights across Thousand Needles. Within its reaches, wyvern prides live under the protection of watchful patriarchs and matriarchs, guarding their nests. The beasts fiercely defend their territory against any intruders who manage to climb into their high domain.

sections.title: A Refuge in the Heights
sections.body: While hostile to outsiders, the high cliffs occasionally attract travellers and hunters willing to brave the dangerous ascent. The tauren scout Pao'ka Swiftmountain is stranded on these perilous heights and needs help reaching Whitereach Post. For adventurers journeying through the canyon, scaling the ramp to Highperch means contending with dozens of razor-sharp talons and venomous tails.

faq.answer: Highperch is inhabited exclusively by wild wyverns and wind riders. You will encounter protective patriarchs, consorts, soaring adults defending their clifftop nests.
Highperch is situated in western Thousand Needles, accessible via a winding ramp that leads up from the southern wall of the canyon floor.

faq.q: Why is Highperch significant to the Horde?
aliases: why do orcs care about highperch
faq.answer: Wyverns, also known as wind riders, are the vital flying mounts of the Horde, having allied with the orcs during the Third War. Natural roosts like Highperch represent the wild heritage and thriving population of these loyal beasts.
Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a tauren scout stranded amidst the deadly wyvern nests on Highperch. He needs an escort to Whitereach Post.

angles.text: The wind riders nesting upon Highperch are close kin to the noble flying mounts that carry the Horde across Kalimdor, making the sanctuary an awe-inspiring sight for Horde champions.
The sprawling aerie offers seasoned hunters a firsthand look at wild wyverns hunting and guarding their nests in their natural, untamed habitat.
